# MyBnBDesign
> Premium interior design for short-term rental properties. A BnB Accelerator company.

## About
MyBnBDesign provides full-service interior design for short-term rental properties (Airbnb, VRBO, vacation rentals). Services include interior design, furnishing and installation, photography staging, and listing optimization. Based in Pittsburgh, PA, serving 40+ markets nationwide.

## Services
- Interior Design: Room-by-room design tailored to property type, market, and target guests
- Furnishing & Installation: Complete procurement, delivery, and installation
- Photography Staging: Staging optimized for listing photography
- Listing Optimization: Photography art direction and listing copy guidance
- Turnkey Packages: Move-in ready solutions from design through installation
